features: Available in 1.3, 2, 3, 5 megapixel and 10 megapixel/1080p dual-mode; color, day/night and auto iris
H.264 (MPEG-4 Part 10): simultaneous support of H.264 and MJPEG, 10x average bandwidth and storage reduction over MJPEG
Multistreaming: up to eight concurrent nonidentical streams with different frame rates, bit rates, resolutions and picture quality
Real-time streaming protocol (RTSP) compatible with media players such as QuickTime, Windows Media Player and VLC
Superior low-light performance: 1/2 in. CMOS sensor
Fastest megapixel image rates: up to 32 fps in 1.3 megapixel mode, 24 fps in 2 megapixel mode
Programmable 1/4 resolution initiated by motion detection or alarm inputs
Region of interest (ROI), image cropping, motion detection, motorized IR-cut filter
